config.hero: a seasick mapmaker pressed into a pirate crew
config.setting: a reef that is on no chart

bible.title: The Shifting Shoal Secret
bible.premise: Stolen from your dry inland drafting parlor, you must steer a crew of rowdy pirates through uncharted, churning waters. Draw a true course to the Sunken King's hoard while keeping your breakfast down, or you will walk the plank.
bible.heart: You swore to your little brother that you would return home safely with enough coin to buy a quiet farm far from the sea.
bible.goal: Find the Sunken King's golden strongbox and secure your share of the plunder so you can buy passage home.
bible.danger: Cobb, the treacherous first mate, plots to seize your chart, maroon the crew, and leave you behind to sink with the wreck.
bible.world: Muddle Reef is a sun-bleached labyrinth of jagged coral towers, echoing sea caves, and whistling stone arches. The water glows bright turquoise over sudden shallows, and the razor-sharp shoals shift every time the ocean tide turns. The only harbor is Driftwood Spire, a rickety settlement lashed together from old ship timbers, where outlaws trade rum and rumors.

characters.name: Jago
characters.description: Captain Jago, a booming pirate skipper who is terrified of sea curses and desperately wants to strike it rich without angering the ocean spirits.

characters.name: Cobb
characters.description: Cobb, the sneaky first mate with a sly grin who wants to mutiny, steal your charts, and hoard every scrap of gold for himself.

characters.name: Nell
characters.description: Nell, the quick-witted ship's cook and lookout who dreams of ditching pirate life to buy her own legitimate merchant sloop.

characters.name: Owain
characters.description: Owain, a sunburnt castaway living atop a hollow coral rock who wants ship biscuits, company, and someone to laugh at his sea riddles.

rules: The coral banks shift with each turning tide, closing known channels and opening brand new sea gates.
Ink washes away instantly in sea spray, meaning charts must remain safely tucked inside oiled leather tubes.
Captain Jago will never disobey a supposed seafaring omen or curse, no matter how ridiculous it seems.
Cobb will always attempt to steal any unguarded valuable if left alone with it for more than a minute.

pages.text:
You clutch your brother's crumpled letter inside your coat. Pip expects you home with enough gold to buy a quiet farm, not drowned in pirate waters. You are a parlor clerk, not a sailor, and your stomach churns with every swell.

Captain Jago stomps over, his red beard dripping. He shoves a heavy spyglass into your chest. 'The reef is shifting, ink-splasher!' he roars. 'Steer us through before the tide turns, or the sea ghosts take us both!'

Ahead, two gaps cut the jagged coral. The northern gap is deep but buffeted by fierce gale winds. The southern channel looks calm, though its hidden sandbars could rip the ship's bottom out.

choices.text: Steer into the deep northern gap against the gale.
Guide the ship into the calm, shallow southern channel.

factsAdded.text: You carry your brother Pip's letter reminding you of your farm promise.
Captain Jago ordered you to pilot the ship through the shifting reef.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a crumpled letter folded and sealed with red wax

pages.choiceText: Steer into the deep northern gap against the gale.
pages.text:
The wooden ship plunges into the northern gap. Icy spray stings your face. The gale howls like a banshee, but the keel clears the coral teeth below. You hold your ground at the helm, knuckles white, keeping Pip's promised farm in mind.

A shadow slips up beside you. It is Cobb, the first mate, grinning with crooked teeth. 'Fine steering, clerk,' he purrs, his hand drifting toward your chart tube. 'Hand over the map. The captain's nerves are rattled, and a clever lad knows who truly runs this deck.'

Behind Cobb, Captain Jago is bellowing at the crew to haul lines. If Cobb takes your map, you are dead weight.

choices.text: Shout for Captain Jago and shove Cobb away.
Bargain with Cobb for a cut of the plunder.

factsAdded.text: Cobb cornered you at the helm to demand your chart tube.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a wooden sailing ship plunging through rough waves between sharp coral rocks

pages.choiceText: Guide the ship into the calm, shallow southern channel.
pages.text:
You check your brass compass and guide the ship into the glassy turquoise channel. The wind dies instantly. Captain Jago lets out a booming laugh, but your relief is cut short when the keel screeches over hidden sand. The ship jolts to a dead stop, wedged fast against a creeping shoal.

First mate Cobb appears at your elbow, flashing a sly, yellow-toothed grin. 'Splendid work, parlor boy,' he murmurs, eyeing your oiled chart tube. 'The falling tide will crack our ribs within the hour. Hand over that map so I can find a towline path, or I'll tell Jago you wrecked us on purpose.'

Across the deck, Jago is shaking his fists at a passing gull, terrified of the omen.

choices.text: Refuse Cobb and call Captain Jago over to inspect the sandbar.
Bargain with Cobb and trade the chart tube for his silence.

factsAdded.text: The ship is wedged fast upon a sandbar with the tide falling.
First mate Cobb threatened to blame you for the grounding unless you hand over your chart tube.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a brass pocket compass resting on a weathered wooden ship railing

pages.choiceText: Shout for Captain Jago and shove Cobb away.
pages.text:
You plant your heels and shove Cobb hard with both hands. Cobb stumbles backward into a coil of rope with an angry hiss. 'Captain!' you bellow over the screeching wind. 'Hands off the wheel!'

Captain Jago whirls around, his wild eyes blazing. Before Cobb can spin a lie, an iron skillet clatters across the deck. Nell, the sharp-eyed cook, drops from the rigging with a grin. 'The clerk speaks true, Captain,' Nell calls. 'Cobb was sniffing after the charts like an alley cat.'

Jago stomps between you both, gripping his sea-charm necklace. He glares at Cobb, then scowls at you. 'Mutiny on my deck brings a drowned man's curse!' Jago roars. 'Someone proves their loyalty right now, or you both swim!'

choices.text: Offer a risky navigational shortcut to prove your worth.
Side with Nell and demand Cobb be stripped of rank.

factsAdded.text: Nell backed your word against Cobb in front of Captain Jago.
Captain Jago demanded immediate proof of your crew loyalty.

pages.illustrationPrompt: two hands shoving a pirate back against the wooden ship railing

pages.choiceText: Bargain with Cobb for a cut of the plunder.
pages.text:
"Two shares of gold," you say quietly, "or I pitch the charts into the foaming sea."

Cobb's crooked grin widens, and he nods fast. "Done, clerk. We split the Sunken King's chest behind the captain's back."

A wooden spoon smacks Cobb across the ear. Nell, the sharp-eyed cook, glares at you both. "Plot later," she mutters. "A black gull just landed on the mast, and Jago has lost his wits."

Captain Jago is on his knees, wailing that the bird brings a sea curse. He orders the crew to drop anchor right inside this narrow coral throat. If you halt now, the shifting tide will crush the hull to matchsticks.

choices.text: Tell Jago the gull is a lucky omen.
Seize the ship's wheel with Cobb.

factsAdded.text: You agreed to split the Sunken King's gold secretly with Cobb.
Nell caught you and Cobb plotting behind Captain Jago's back.
Captain Jago ordered the crew to drop anchor because of a black gull.

pages.illustrationPrompt: two figures whispering in conspiratorial conference near the ship's helm

pages.choiceText: Refuse Cobb and call Captain Jago over to inspect the sandbar.
Bargain with Cobb and trade the chart tube for his silence.

Tell Jago the gull is a lucky omen.
pages.text:
"That is no curse, Captain!" you shout, pointing up at the black bird. "In the old charts, a black gull marks sovereign gold. Drop anchor now, and you spit in fortune's eye!"

Captain Jago blinks, then scrambles up with a booming laugh. "A gold-bringer! Belay that anchor! Keep her flying, lads!"

The ship leaps forward, just clearing the jagged reef. But Nell yanks your sleeve, gesturing toward the hatch. Cobb has slipped below to rifle through the captain's cabin while everyone tends the sails.

choices.text: Hand the wheel to Nell and stop Cobb below.
Keep steering the ship and ignore Cobb for now.

factsAdded.text: Captain Jago believes the black gull brings good fortune.
Cobb slipped below to loot the captain's cabin.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a dark seagull perched atop a tall wooden mast

pages.choiceText: Seize the ship's wheel with Cobb.
pages.text:
You throw your weight onto the wheel beside Cobb. The ship veers hard, snapping the heavy anchor rope before it can bite the seabed. Captain Jago howls from the deck, clutching his lucky charm as the black gull screeches overhead. The hull scrapes past the coral teeth and bursts into the calm lagoon beyond.

You saved the ship, but Jago is purple with fury. "Mutiny!" he bellows, raising a stout belaying pin.

Cobb draws a brass pistol, grinning wickedly. "One shove and the fool feeds the fishes," he whispers. "Back me up." Nell leaps forward, brandishing an iron ladle. "Don't you dare, clerk! Help me disarm this snake!"

choices.text: Tackle Cobb before he can shoot Captain Jago.
Help Cobb shove Captain Jago overboard.

factsAdded.text: You and Cobb steered the ship safely through the coral into the lagoon.
Cobb pulled a pistol on Captain Jago.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A thick rope snapping against an iron anchor.

pages.choiceText: Hand the wheel to Nell and stop Cobb below.
Keep steering the ship and ignore Cobb for now.
Tackle Cobb before he can shoot Captain Jago.
pages.text:
You throw your weight into Cobb, grabbing his gun arm. His brass pistol cracks loudly, blasting a hole through the mainsail. Nell's iron ladle catches him squarely on the chin. Cobb collapses in a heap, and Captain Jago draws his notched sword with a furious roar.

"Traitorous bilge rat!" Jago thunders, pinning Cobb to the deck.

Cobb groans, rubbing his bruised jaw, but sneers up at you. "The clerk was in on it, Captain! We swore to split the gold!"

Nell narrows her eyes. "He did scheme with Cobb, Captain. But he just saved your hide, too."

Ahead, the sunken ribs of the treasure wreck gleam through clear water. The tide is already turning, foaming white around the coral.

choices.text: Confess the plot and pledge your share to Jago.
Dive overboard to retrieve the treasure chest yourself.

factsAdded.text: Cobb is disarmed and pinned on deck.
Captain Jago knows you and Cobb plotted behind his back.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A notched pirate sword gripped in a calloused fist.

pages.choiceText: Help Cobb shove Captain Jago overboard.
pages.text:
You slam your shoulder into Captain Jago. Cobb heaves with a grunt. Jago’s hand claws desperately at the rail before he slips, crashing into the bright lagoon with an almighty splash. He bobs back up, sputtering foam and cursing every ancestor you ever had.

Nell drops her iron ladle onto the deck. "You fools," she whispers, backing toward the galley door. "You threw away our only seasoned sailor."

Cobb just laughs, turning the brass pistol straight at your chest. His crooked grin gleams. "Much obliged, clerk. Hand over the leather chart tube, or keep the old man company in the drink."

choices.text: Bluff that only you can decipher the drafting symbols.
Signal Nell to tackle Cobb together.

factsAdded.text: You helped Cobb throw Captain Jago overboard into the lagoon.
Cobb betrayed you and demanded your chart tube at gunpoint.
